description: This file contains the implementation of a trie-based policy enforcer for access control, which builds and manipulates trie indices of policies to check permissions based on resource keys, authorization subjects, and policies. It includes class definitions for 'TrieBasedPolicyEnforcer' with methods for policy evaluation and JSON view construction.

classes.name: TrieBasedPolicyEnforcer
classes.description: Implements a trie-based policy enforcement mechanism that evaluates permissions and constructs JSON views based on hierarchical policies.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Constructs a new TrieBasedPolicyEnforcer instance from a given policy.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the resource has unrestricted permissions for the given authorization context.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the resource has partial permissions for the given authorization context.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves the IDs of subjects who have the specified permission on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves the subjects who have the specified permission on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Gets IDs of subjects with at least partial permission.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Gets subjects with at least partial permission.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON view of a resource based on authorized fields and permissions.
